Hi Ashley — thanks for the clear ask and the PO draft. Looping Ben and Priya for pricing and billing. High-level options we can run quickly (details in attached offer and MAP):

Option A — One-time top-up (fastest)
- Add requested uplift immediately as a one-time committed bucket.
- Billing: invoice for the top-up on next invoice date; we pro-rate the charged units to your requested start date.
- Co-term: we will calculate the remaining prorated value and either (a) apply a pro-rata credit at co-term or (b) convert leftover value to a voucher for future use — your preference.
- Typical timing: 2–3 business days to create the commitment and start serving.

Option B — Staged voucher (recommended for flexibility)
- Issue a set of vouchers (e.g., 3 x monthly vouchers) that add incremental capacity.
- Billing: vouchers are invoiced upfront or monthly per preference.
- Co-term: vouchers simply expire at co-term; if you want value preserved we can convert unused portion to a limited-time credit.

Discounting: for a temporary uplift we can offer a short promotional adjustment. Attached is a pricing sheet with two paths: a 10% promotional credit applied over 3 invoices (quick, non-binding marketing promo) or a tiered volume discount (8–12%) if you convert the uplift into an annualized 12-month commit.

I've attached an initial offer and a mutual action plan to speed approvals. If you want, Ben and I can do a 20–30 minute call tomorrow to lock the numbers and share how the invoice/credit would appear.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm preferred option (Top-up vs Voucher) and whether the promo is acceptable.
- We finalise the amendment + DocuSign and Priya will outline the invoicing cadence.
